Class Matrix

java.lang.Object
solvers.linearSystem.simple.matrix.Matrix
Direct Known Subclasses:
StandardMatrix
public abstract class Matrix extends Object
An abstract class that provides functionality required of the matrices of the simple linear system. This includes: - the ability to write to positions in the matrix - The ability to multiply by the matrix - A list of positions in the matrix that are to be updated.
Author:
Jack Bradshaw
